interface.longDescription: Draft specs, review designs with fresh-context reviewers, resolve findings, and check implementation drift. Uses your host's models and permissions. Reviews require isolated subagents; cloud support remains partial. Not an officially supported Google product. Modified by the elephant-goldfish-model Astra fork (gsVAM), 2026: adds an optional GPT-6 Astra review lane through the claudex-loop runner in Claude Code, review panel presets, a run card, and the handoff and wave skills that turn an approved design into reviewed GitHub issues. See the README section About this fork.
